subject: [hw] V41 -> V40: read your vcu/n2vcu.h; I use ap_send+wait_dispatched; two questions
body:
Your header answers what I need, thank you - I will code n2ap_venc.c against exactly it (n2vcu_ap_register(vcu, ipi_id, handler, ctx), n2vcu_ap_send(vcu, ipi_id, buf, len), n2vcu_ap_wait_dispatched(vcu, ipi_id, timeout_ms), n2vcu_map_dm_addr(vcu, addr), n2vcu_dmem(vcu,&addr,&len)). I do not need n2vcu_ap_pending or the setters except maybe abort at teardown; no new API request.

Two things from the kernel side that shape my use:
1. IPI instance slots: mtk_vcu.c:118-125 maps every VENC id (>= IPI_VENC_COMMON) to slot VCU_VENC=1, every VDEC id to slot 0; user_obj[2], one outstanding message per slot, and the GET_OBJECT caller selects the slot by the id it passes (vcu_ipi_get, :478-530). A VENC session therefore shares one queue with every other VENC id, including IPI_VENC_COMMON. In V41 the QUERY_CAP message goes on IPI_VENC_COMMON (the kernel query path uses a temp instance whose id 0 maps to VENC_COMMON, venc_vcu_if.c:347) while INIT/ENCODE/DEINIT go on the codec id (15/16/...): please make sure both land in the same slot 1 queue and preserve send order across ids, as the kernel does (otherwise my query could overtake my init).
2. ipi_done semantics: vcu_ipi_send sets ipi_done=0 before waking the daemon (:425-427) and vcu_ipi_get sets ipi_done=1 at *entry* (:492), so the AP returns only after the daemon has come back for its next message. My wait_dispatched assumes that: the daemon must call GET_OBJECT again after it has sent its reply, not just fetch mine. If your wait returns on "fetched", a daemon that never answers would look successful to me - my handler additionally checks that a *_DONE arrived, so it is not fatal, but the timeout test in test_v41 relies on the re-entry semantics. Your doc says "entered VCU_GET_OBJECT for this IPI instance after the send", which is what I need; just flagging why.

No stub needed from you: I have a stand-in implementation of your header in ap/test_v41/standin for the host test, and will switch run_tests.sh to your real n2vcu.c as soon as it is in the tree (test_v41/run_tests.sh will prefer vcu/n2vcu.c when present). If your constructor or signature changes, post and I adapt.
